name: aerial_touch_long_flight_full_credit
description: Blue car launched at z 700 with velocity (0, 800, 1100); the ball launched from z 500 with vz 1200. Both are ballistic so gravity cancels in their relative motion; they meet about 2.0 s in (ball near its apex at z about 1600), the contact begins about 1.8 s in. Hand calc: airFrac = min(1, 1.8/1.75) = 1; ballFrac = min(1, (1600-150)/1300) = 1; impulse 1. Reward about 1.0. Observed in the engine: contact at frame 28 (1.87 s) pays exactly 1.0; a second, low touch near frame 59 adds about 0.05 (not modelled by the hand calculation; bounded by the last expectation).

expect.intent: the car really touches the ball (PassingSetupReward's touched_ball gate is the witness; AerialTouchReward emits no gates)
a high ball hit after a long flight (contact at about 1.87 s, frame 28) earns the full 1.0, paid once
no farming: later touches (the ball and car meet again near frame 59) add only a small tail, well under a second full payment
